description: This file contains middleware functions for instrumenting HTTP handlers with Prometheus metrics, including request duration, in-flight requests, request size, response size, and request result counters. It also includes utility functions for label handling and metric description validation.

methods.name: observeWithExemplar
methods.description: Wrapper for prometheus.ExemplarObserver.ObserveWithExemplar and fallback to Observe.

methods.name: addWithExemplar
methods.description: Wrapper for prometheus.ExemplarAdder.AddWithExemplar and fallback to Counter.Add.

methods.name: InstrumentHandlerInFlight
methods.description: Middleware to track in-flight requests using a Gauge.

methods.name: InstrumentHandlerDuration
methods.description: Middleware to observe request duration with labels for code and method.

methods.name: InstrumentHandlerCounter
methods.description: Middleware to count requests with labels for code and method.

methods.name: InstrumentHandlerTimeToWriteHeader
methods.description: Middleware to measure time until response headers are written.

methods.name: checkLabels
methods.description: Validates if a collector has 'code' and/or 'method' labels, panics on invalid.

methods.name: isLabelCurried
methods.description: Checks if a label is curried in a metric vector.

methods.name: labels
methods.description: Generates label set for metrics based on request info and extra methods.

methods.name: computeApproximateRequestSize
methods.description: Estimates the size of an HTTP request in bytes.

methods.name: sanitizeMethod
methods.description: Sanitizes HTTP method names, extending with extra methods if provided.

methods.name: sanitizeCode
methods.description: Sanitizes HTTP status codes, returning 'unknown' for invalid codes.
